fields.name: Valid Accounts
fields.description: Adversaries may obtain and abuse credentials of existing accounts as a means of gaining Initial Access, Persistence, Privilege Escalation, or Defense Evasion.
fields.trigger_evidence: EventCode=4624 from unusual IP or at unusual time

fields.name: PowerShell
fields.description: Adversaries may abuse PowerShell commands and scripts for execution. PowerShell is included in all versions of Windows.
fields.trigger_evidence: Process creation with powershell.exe, especially with -enc or -encodedcommand flags

fields.name: Windows Command Shell
fields.description: Adversaries may abuse the Windows command shell (cmd.exe) for execution.
fields.trigger_evidence: cmd.exe launched by unusual parent process or with suspicious command line

fields.name: Create Account: Local Account
fields.description: Adversaries may create a local account to maintain access to victim systems.

fields.name: Account Manipulation
fields.description: Adversaries may manipulate accounts to maintain access to victim systems, such as modifying group membership.

fields.name: Create or Modify System Process: Windows Service
fields.description: Adversaries may create or modify Windows services to repeatedly execute malicious payloads.

fields.name: Scheduled Task/Job: Scheduled Task
fields.description: Adversaries may abuse task scheduling to execute malicious code at system startup or on a scheduled basis.

fields.name: Boot or Logon Autostart Execution: Registry Run Keys
fields.description: Adversaries may achieve persistence by adding a program to a startup folder or registering it with a Registry run key.
fields.trigger_evidence: Sysmon registry modification events on Run/RunOnce keys

fields.name: OS Credential Dumping: LSASS Memory
fields.description: Adversaries may attempt to access credential material stored in the process memory of LSASS.
fields.trigger_evidence: Sysmon process access events targeting lsass.exe

fields.name: Remote Services: Remote Desktop Protocol
fields.description: Adversaries may use Valid Accounts to log into a computer using RDP.

fields.name: Remote Services: SMB/Windows Admin Shares
fields.description: Adversaries may use Valid Accounts to interact with a remote network share using SMB.
fields.trigger_evidence: EventCode=4624 with LogonType=3 + share access events

fields.name: Archive Collected Data
fields.description: An adversary may compress and/or encrypt data prior to exfiltration using common utilities.
fields.trigger_evidence: Process creation of 7zip, WinRAR, tar, or similar archive utilities

fields.name: Account Discovery: Local Account
fields.description: Adversaries may attempt to get a listing of local system accounts.
fields.trigger_evidence: Commands like net user, net localgroup

fields.name: Brute Force: Password Guessing
fields.description: Adversaries may brute force passwords to gain access to accounts.
fields.trigger_evidence: Multiple EventCode=4625 (failed logons) from same source in short time
